name: alpha-desktop
description: Alpha desktop shell for Windows — Electron window that orchestrates the local Gateway API and Next.js frontend.
author: Alpha

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.dist: npm run fetch-runtime && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:dir: npm run fetch-runtime && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
